story.summaryEn:
Breaking the 500 km/h barrier! ⚡️
The YANGWANG U9 Xtreme has achieved a top speed of 503.17 km/h in Abu Dhabi, becoming the first production car to surpass the 500 km/h threshold.
The FIA has officially recognised this remarkable speed achievement, marking a significant milestone in electric vehicle technology and automotive engineering 🏆
#FIA 
https://www.fia.com/news/yangwang-u9-xtreme-surpasses-500-kmh-speed-achievement-recognised-fia
detailZh:
突破500公里/小时大关！⚡️
阳光U9 Xtreme在阿布扎比达到了503.17公里/小时的最高速度，成为第一辆突破500公里/小时门槛的量产车。
国际汽联正式认可了这一惊人的速度成就，标志着电动汽车技术和汽车工程的重要里程碑 🏆
#FIA
